label: Shape Intelligence Population
goal: Build a reliable, lightweight, evidence-bound intelligence workflow that turns new content into governed provisional Shape candidates.
purpose: Coordinate population, critique, validation, review, and promotion handoff without owning source ingestion, canonical Shape authority, or Cognitive Aperture retrieval/disclosure.
success_condition: New content is processed asynchronously into provenance-backed, schema-valid provisional Shape candidates that are independently critiqued, deterministically validated, evaluated, and promoted only by a designated canonical authority.
external_dependencies: OpenClaw gateway and dedicated agent identities
Unified Metaphysical Framework Shape and Semantic Addressing profile
canonical Shape owner and promotion governance
existing source provenance, chunking, and knowledge-ocean registries
objectives: Define evidence-packet and provisional-Shape candidate contracts.
Configure bounded OpenClaw proposer, critic, and synthesizer identities.
Implement deterministic validation, idempotent job control, and durable provenance.
Keep candidate creation separate from canonical promotion and retrieval ranking.
Establish evaluation, observability, cost, safety, and promotion-quality gates.
scope_out: Replacing Cognitive Aperture retrieval or disclosure services.
Embedding provider or vector database selection.
Treating legacy deterministic signatures as canonical Shapes.
Open-ended autonomous execution with broad filesystem, shell, or network access.
